sub_opere._meta: Individually-known pieces inside a collective sigla (e.g. a miscellany like SD) that are notable enough to deserve their own card in opere.html, even though they don't have their own official sigla in the siglario. `parentSigla` is the collective sigla they belong to; `matchTitle` is matched (loosely, ignoring a trailing full stop) against items.json titles within that sigla's themes to find their linked schede — a sub-opera card only appears if at least one matching item exists.
